description: Verify that a claimed tool output matches its declared sha256 hash. Use this to detect hallucinated or tampered data: pass the response payload (or its stable subset: tool, endpoint, status, result) and the hash that was reported alongside it. Returns { valid: true } if the recomputed hash matches, { valid: false, expected_hash, actual_hash } otherwise. Note: the hash is computed over the JSON-stringified form of { tool, endpoint, status, result } in that exact key order. This tool is for downstream verifiers (audit logs, report reviewers, external scripts), not for in-band self-verification by the LLM.

endpoint.description: The redacted endpoint URL from the original response.

hash.description: The sha256 hash claimed to correspond to the tool output (64 hex chars).

result.description: The result payload from the original response (any type).

status.description: The HTTP status code from the original response.

tool.description: The tool name from the original response.

name: verify_output_integrity
